title: The Memoryless Best-Choice Problem
summary: A random sequence sampled from a known continuous distribution is observed with the objective to choose an item with the overall rank one. A rejected item cannot be recalled and is immediately erased from the memory. Under this memory constraint, the choice problem is not amenable to recursive methods of optimal stopping and becomes a global optimisation task. We focus on a heavy-traffic form of the problem with infinitely many choice opportunities, which we state in terms of a planar Poisson process (PPP).
